Honda1400

If the total income of Honda from two wheelers sold is Rs.84 million and selling prices of each two-wheeler of Hero and Bajaj are 20% and 25% less than the selling price of each two-wheeler of Honda, then what is the total income of Hero and Bajaj together in the year 2016?
questions.solution_en:
Total revenue of Honda is Rs.84 million =Rs.84000000

Selling price of each two-wheeler= (84000000/1400) =Rs.60000

Selling price of each two-wheeler of Hero= (80/100) x 60000 = Rs.48000

Total income of Hero = 48000 x 1200 = Rs.57600000

Selling price of each two-wheeler of Bajaj= (75/100) x 60000 = Rs.45000

Total income of Bajaj = 45000 x 1520 = Rs.68400000

Total income =57600000 +68400000 =Rs.126000000 =126 million.

questions.q_en:
Following table shows amount invested by five partners in a business for same time period

PartnersInvestment
P9000₹
Q15000₹
R12000₹
S21000₹
T18000₹

Answer following question based on above information:

If they all together make a total profit of 25000₹, calculate the profit earned by P and R together?
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of investment made by all = P: Q: R: S: T =

9000: 15000: 12000: 21000: 18000 = 9: 15: 12: 21: 18 = 3: 5: 4: 7: 6

Share of profit would be equivalent to share of investment, thus

P's share of profit = (3/25) x 25000 = 3000₹

R's share of profit = (4/25) x 25000 = 4000₹

Total = 3000+4000 = 7000₹
